description:
Fetches a PDF that is already online and prepares it as a private draft.

    Use this when the user gives a link, or when your host hands you an
    attachment as a download URL rather than a local file. For a file on the
    user's machine, use foliade_prepare_upload instead.

    Only public https links are accepted, and the server checks that the link
    really returns a PDF. Call foliade_finalize_upload next with the upload_id.
name: foliade_import_url
title: Import a PDF from a public link
